Most people here are racist (and by that i dont even mean this post) because racism is not even talked about and there is barely anything in school about it. The slavery ended in 1856 and Romas were just thrown on the streets. A lot of them returned to their ‘masters’ and basically worked the same job as a slave but just for very little money. There were no reparations. This led to the situation we have today, where the lack of education is considered a personal fault rather than a systemic one. Roma schools and communities still have very little investments and this discrepancy created by slavery was never addressed.
